title: 2분이면 끝
코디 공식 3개

segments.label: 핼러윈 데일리룩
en: Halloween's tomorrow — I just added one orange piece
01 Black outfit + a pumpkin-orange beanie (a scarf or socks work too)
02 Easiest one: a leopard satin skirt, everything else black
03 Guys in all black: mix knit, satin and leather textures
Save it before your weekend plans — Sources: KMA forecast, Dazed

segments.label: 두 색 코디 6벌
en: The easiest way to dress: remember just two colors
Chocolate & sky blue: work blazer (easiest), date cardigan, weekend trucker
Burgundy & grey: double blazer, cable knit, quilted jacket
Formula: split two colors top and bottom; dark outside, light inside
Save it for weekend mornings — Source: KMA forecast

segments.label: 하체 고민 2룩
segments.sub: 밝은 색은 위, 아래는 한 톤
en: Self-conscious about your lower half? Start with your tights color
Look 1: butter-yellow cropped cardigan, navy A-line skirt, navy tights and shoes
Look 2: ivory short puffer, indigo wide jeans long enough to reach the shoes
Formula: light on top, one tone below, short on top and long below
Save it before you shop — Source (Look 2): Allure Korea

outro_en: Save & follow @zzebi.st for daily 1-min style tips
